#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)
// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular

bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
    // A is stored in row-major order
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
            double sum = 0.0;
            
            if (i == j) {
                // Diagonal element
                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];
                }
                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;
                if (val <= 0.0) {
                    // Matrix is not positive definite
                    printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\n", j);
                    return false;
                }
                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);
            } else {
                // Off-diagonal element
                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];
                }
                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];
            }
        }
        
        // Zero out upper triangular part
        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix
void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random
    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite
    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite
    
    std::vector<double> B(n * n);
    unsigned int seed = 42;
    
    // Generate random matrix B
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {
        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;
    }
    
    // Compute A = B * B^T
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];
            }
            A[i * n + j] = sum;
        }
    }
    
    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        A[i * n + i] += n;
    }
}

bool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {
    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix
    
    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);
    
    // Compute L * L^T
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];
            }
            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;
        }
    }
    
    // Compare with original
    double maxError = 0.0;
    double relError = 0.0;
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {
        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);
        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);
        
        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);
        relError = std::max(relError, rel);
    }
    
    printf("Max absolute error: %.10e\n", maxError);
    printf("Max relative error: %.10e\n", relError);
    
    // Check if error is within tolerance
    if (relError > 1e-6) {
        printf("Validation failed: relative error too large\n");
        return false;
    }
    
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    size_t n = 512;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    
    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            n = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    printf("Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\n");
    printf("Matrix size: %zu x %zu\n", n, n);
    printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    
    // Allocate matrix
    std::vector<double> A(n * n);
    std::vector<double> A_orig;
    
    // Generate positive definite matrix
    printf("Generating positive definite matrix...\n");
    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);
    
    if (validate) {
        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation
    }
    
    // Perform Cholesky decomposition
    printf("Computing Cholesky decomposition...\n");
    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    
    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);
    
    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);
    
    if (!success) {
        printf("Cholesky decomposition failed\n");
        return 1;
    }
    
    printf("Computation time: %ld ms\n", duration.count());
    
    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)
    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;
    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;
    printf("Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\n", gflops);
    
    // Print results for external validation
    if (printResults) {
        print_results(A, "CholeskyL");
    }
    
    // Validation
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating result...\n");
        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);
        
        if (valid) {
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cinttypes>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#include "hash.hpp"

// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum
template <typename T>
T kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {
    T sum = 0.0;
    T c = 0.0;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        T y = val - c;
        T t = sum + y;
        c = (t - sum) - y;
        sum = t;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Print results for floating-point arrays
template <typename T>
void print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute statistics
    T sum = kahan_sum(data);
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Sum: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(sum));
    printf("Min: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %.17e\n", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)
template <typename T>
void print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Compute min/max
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Min: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %lld\n", indices[i], static_cast<long long>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

The benchmark is currently a replicated, sequential row-major implementation. I’m switching it to a distributed contiguous-row layout: matrix generation uses an MPI ring so no rank needs the full matrix, and the factorization uses blocked left-looking Cholesky with one panel collective per block plus local triangular solves. Results/validation remain root-only and retain the original command-line behavior.
The code and MPI toolchain are available. The implementation will use distributed contiguous row blocks with blocked panel communication, while gathering only for requested result printing or validation.

+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        int rank = 0;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI message is too large for MPI_Gatherv/Allgatherv\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(communicator, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    return static_cast<int>(count);

+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    ends.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < process_count; ++rank) {
+        starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank + 1) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+    }

+int ownerOfRow(const std::vector<std::size_t>& ends, const std::size_t row) {
+    // Empty row blocks are possible when there are more ranks than rows.
+    // upper_bound therefore selects the first non-empty block containing row.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(ends.begin(), ends.end(), row) - ends.begin());

+// Blocked left-looking Cholesky.  At the start of a block, the rows of the
+// already factored panel needed by that block are all-gathered once.  Each

+// broadcast, so the full matrix is never replicated during the factorization.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local_a, const std::size_t n,
+                           const std::size_t row_start, const std::size_t local_rows,

+namespace {

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        int rank = 0;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI message is too large for MPI_Gatherv/Allgatherv\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(communicator, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    return static_cast<int>(count);
+}
+
+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    ends.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < process_count; ++rank) {
+        starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank + 1) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+    }
+}
+
+int ownerOfRow(const std::vector<std::size_t>& ends, const std::size_t row) {
+    // Empty row blocks are possible when there are more ranks than rows.
+    // upper_bound therefore selects the first non-empty block containing row.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(ends.begin(), ends.end(), row) - ends.begin());
+}
+

+// Blocked left-looking Cholesky.  At the start of a block, the rows of the
+// already factored panel needed by that block are all-gathered once.  Each

+// Only the small diagonal block is gathered to one rank for POTRF and then
+// broadcast, so the full matrix is never replicated during the factorization.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local_a, const std::size_t n,

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        int rank = 0;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI message is too large for MPI_Gatherv/Allgatherv\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(communicator, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    return static_cast<int>(count);

+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    ends.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < process_count; ++rank) {
+        starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank + 1) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+    }

+    // upper_bound therefore selects the first non-empty block containing row.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(ends.begin(), ends.end(), row) - ends.begin());

+                    MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal.data(), diagonal_counts.data(),
+                    diagonal_displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal_root, communicator);

+                    sum += value * value;

+                                block_start + row);

+        }

+                }

+namespace {

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        int rank = 0;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI message is too large for MPI_Gatherv/Allgatherv\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(communicator, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    return static_cast<int>(count);
+}
+
+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    ends.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < process_count; ++rank) {
+        starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank + 1) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+    }
+}
+
+int ownerOfRow(const std::vector<std::size_t>& ends, const std::size_t row) {
+    // Empty row blocks are possible when there are more ranks than rows.
+    // upper_bound therefore selects the first non-empty block containing row.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(ends.begin(), ends.end(), row) - ends.begin());
+}
+
+// Generate A = B * B^T + nI without constructing B or A on every rank.
+// Ranks generate contiguous pieces of the original rand_r stream, then a
+// ring exchanges B's row blocks so each rank can form its own rows of A.
+void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& local_a, const std::size_t n,
+                                    const std::size_t row_start,
+                                    const std::size_t local_rows,
+                                    const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_starts,
+                                    const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_ends,
+                                    const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int process_count = 1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+    MPI_Comm_size(communicator, &process_count);
+
+    std::vector<double> local_b(local_rows * n);
+
+    // Passing the rand_r state along the row partition preserves the input
+    // matrix generated by the sequential benchmark exactly, without making
+    // random-number generation a replicated-memory operation.
+    unsigned int seed = 42;
+    if (rank != 0) {
+        MPI_Recv(&seed, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED, rank - 1, 4100, communicator, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);
+    }
+    for (double& value : local_b) {
+        value = (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 0.5;
+    }
+    if (rank + 1 < process_count) {
+        MPI_Send(&seed, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED, rank + 1, 4100, communicator);
+    }
+
+    local_a.assign(local_rows * n, 0.0);
+
+    std::size_t maximum_rows = 0;
+    for (int process = 0; process < process_count; ++process) {

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        int rank = 0;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI message is too large for MPI_Gatherv/Allgatherv\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(communicator, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    return static_cast<int>(count);

+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    ends.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < process_count; ++rank) {
+        starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank + 1) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+    }
+}

+int ownerOfRow(const std::vector<std::size_t>& ends, const std::size_t row) {
+    // Empty row blocks are possible when there are more ranks than rows.
+    // upper_bound therefore selects the first non-empty block containing row.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(ends.begin(), ends.end(), row) - ends.begin());

+        for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
+            const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;

+            const std::size_t diagonal_row = row - block_start;

+                    value -= matrix_row[block_start + k] * diagonal[column * block_rows + k];
+                }

+                    value / diagonal[column * block_rows + column];

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        int rank = 0;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI message is too large for MPI_Gatherv/Allgatherv\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(communicator, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    return static_cast<int>(count);
+}
+
+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    ends.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < process_count; ++rank) {
+        starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank + 1) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+    }
+}
+
+int ownerOfRow(const std::vector<std::size_t>& ends, const std::size_t row) {
+    // Empty row blocks are possible when there are more ranks than rows.
+    // upper_bound therefore selects the first non-empty block containing row.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(ends.begin(), ends.end(), row) - ends.begin());
+}

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        int rank = 0;

+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));

+                    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < block_start; ++k) {

+                        diagonal_to_gather.data() + (row - local_block_start) * block_rows);
+        }

+            const std::size_t process_last =
+                std::min(row_ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_end);
+            const std::size_t process_rows =
+                process_last > process_first ? process_last - process_first : 0;

+                mpiCount((process_rows == 0 ? 0 : process_first - block_start) * block_rows,

+                    const double value = diagonal[row * block_rows + k];
+                    sum += value * value;
+                }

+                const double value = diagonal[row * block_rows + row] - sum;

+                                block_start + row);
+                    factorization_ok = 0;
+                    break;
+                }

+                    double off_diagonal = diagonal[below * block_rows + row];

+        }

+                  diagonal_root, communicator);
+
+        // Install the factored diagonal block on its distributed rows.
+        for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
+            const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;
+            double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
+            const std::size_t diagonal_row = row - block_start;
+            for (std::size_t column = 0; column <= diagonal_row; ++column) {
+                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
+                    diagonal[diagonal_row * block_rows + column];
+            }
+        }

+        // Solve L(i, block) * L(block, block)^T = A(i, block) for rows below
+        // the diagonal block.  This is independent for every local row.
+        for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
+            const std::size_t row = row_start + local_row;
+            if (row < block_end) {

+            }

+            for (std::size_t column = 0; column < block_rows; ++column) {
+                double value = matrix_row[block_start + column];
+                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < column; ++k) {
+                    value -= matrix_row[block_start + k] * diagonal[column * block_rows + k];
+                }
+                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
+                    value / diagonal[column * block_rows + column];
+            }

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        int rank = 0;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI message is too large for MPI_Gatherv/Allgatherv\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(communicator, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    return static_cast<int>(count);
+}
+
+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    ends.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < process_count; ++rank) {
+        starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank + 1) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+    }
+}
+
+int ownerOfRow(const std::vector<std::size_t>& ends, const std::size_t row) {
+    // Empty row blocks are possible when there are more ranks than rows.
+    // upper_bound therefore selects the first non-empty block containing row.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(ends.begin(), ends.end(), row) - ends.begin());
+}

+// Ranks generate contiguous pieces of the original rand_r stream, then a
+// ring exchanges B's row blocks so each rank can form its own rows of A.
+void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& local_a, const std::size_t n,

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        int rank = 0;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI message is too large for MPI_Gatherv/Allgatherv\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(communicator, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    return static_cast<int>(count);

+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    ends.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < process_count; ++rank) {
+        starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank + 1) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+    }

+    // Empty row blocks are possible when there are more ranks than rows.
+    // upper_bound therefore selects the first non-empty block containing row.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(ends.begin(), ends.end(), row) - ends.begin());

+// Only the small diagonal block is gathered to one rank for POTRF and then
+// broadcast, so the full matrix is never replicated during the factorization.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local_a, const std::size_t n,
+                           const std::size_t row_start, const std::size_t local_rows,
+                           const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_starts,
+                           const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_ends,
+                           const MPI_Comm communicator, const std::size_t requested_block_size) {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int process_count = 1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+    MPI_Comm_size(communicator, &process_count);
+
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
     }
-    
-    // Compute A = B * B^T
-    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
-        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
-            double sum = 0.0;
-            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
-                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];
+
+    const std::size_t block_size = std::max<std::size_t>(1, std::min(requested_block_size, n));
+    std::vector<int> panel_counts(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    std::vector<int> panel_displacements(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    std::vector<int> diagonal_counts(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    std::vector<int> diagonal_displacements(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+
+    for (std::size_t block_start = 0; block_start < n; block_start += block_size) {
+        const std::size_t block_rows = std::min(block_size, n - block_start);
+        const std::size_t block_end = block_start + block_rows;
+
+        const std::size_t local_block_start = std::max(row_start, block_start);
+        const std::size_t local_block_end = std::min(row_start + local_rows, block_end);
+        const std::size_t local_block_row_count =
+            local_block_end > local_block_start ? local_block_end - local_block_start : 0;
+
+        std::vector<double> previous_panel;
+        if (block_start != 0) {
+            previous_panel.assign(block_rows * block_start, 0.0);
+            std::vector<double> panel_to_share(local_block_row_count * block_start);
+
+            for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
+                const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;
+                std::copy_n(local_a.data() + local_row * n, block_start,
+                            panel_to_share.data() + (row - local_block_start) * block_start);
+            }
+
+            for (int process = 0; process < process_count; ++process) {
+                const std::size_t process_first =
+                    std::max(row_starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_start);
+                const std::size_t process_last =
+                    std::min(row_ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_end);
+                const std::size_t process_rows =
+                    process_last > process_first ? process_last - process_first : 0;
+                panel_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
+                    mpiCount(process_rows * block_start, communicator);
+                panel_displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
+                    mpiCount((process_rows == 0 ? 0 : process_first - block_start) * block_start,
+                             communicator);
+            }
+
+            MPI_Allgatherv(panel_to_share.data(),
+                           panel_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)], MPI_DOUBLE,
+                           previous_panel.data(), panel_counts.data(), panel_displacements.data(),
+                           MPI_DOUBLE, communicator);
+
+            // Update the current panel with the contribution from all earlier
+            // columns.  The inner product order is kept increasing in k, as
+            // in the original unblocked implementation.
+            for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
+                const std::size_t row = row_start + local_row;
+                if (row < block_start) {
+                    continue;
+                }
+
+                double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
+                const std::size_t row_end = std::min(row + 1, block_end);
+                for (std::size_t column = block_start; column < row_end; ++column) {
+                    double value = matrix_row[column];
+                    const double* const panel_row =
+                        previous_panel.data() + (column - block_start) * block_start;
+                    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < block_start; ++k) {
+                        value -= matrix_row[k] * panel_row[k];
+                    }
+                    matrix_row[column] = value;
+                }
             }
-            A[i * n + j] = sum;
         }
+
+        std::vector<double> diagonal_to_gather(local_block_row_count * block_rows);
+        for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
+            const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;
+            std::copy_n(local_a.data() + local_row * n + block_start, block_rows,
+                        diagonal_to_gather.data() + (row - local_block_start) * block_rows);
+        }
+
+        for (int process = 0; process < process_count; ++process) {
+            const std::size_t process_first =
+                std::max(row_starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_start);
+            const std::size_t process_last =
+                std::min(row_ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_end);
+            const std::size_t process_rows =
+                process_last > process_first ? process_last - process_first : 0;
+            diagonal_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
+                mpiCount(process_rows * block_rows, communicator);
+            diagonal_displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
+                mpiCount((process_rows == 0 ? 0 : process_first - block_start) * block_rows,
+                         communicator);
+        }
+
+        const int diagonal_root = ownerOfRow(row_ends, block_start);
+        std::vector<double> diagonal(block_rows * block_rows, 0.0);
+        MPI_Gatherv(diagonal_to_gather.data(), diagonal_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)],
+                    MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal.data(), diagonal_counts.data(),
+                    diagonal_displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal_root, communicator);
+
+        int factorization_ok = 1;
+        if (rank == diagonal_root) {
+            for (std::size_t row = 0; row < block_rows; ++row) {
+                double sum = 0.0;
+                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < row; ++k) {
+                    const double value = diagonal[row * block_rows + k];
+                    sum += value * value;
+                }
+
+                const double value = diagonal[row * block_rows + row] - sum;
+                if (value <= 0.0) {
+                    std::printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\n",
+                                block_start + row);
+                    factorization_ok = 0;
+                    break;
+                }
+                diagonal[row * block_rows + row] = std::sqrt(value);
+
+                for (std::size_t below = row + 1; below < block_rows; ++below) {
+                    double off_diagonal = diagonal[below * block_rows + row];
+                    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < row; ++k) {
+                        off_diagonal -= diagonal[below * block_rows + k] *
+                                        diagonal[row * block_rows + k];
+                    }
+                    diagonal[below * block_rows + row] =
+                        off_diagonal / diagonal[row * block_rows + row];
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Bcast(&factorization_ok, 1, MPI_INT, diagonal_root, communicator);
+        if (!factorization_ok) {
+            return false;
+        }
+        MPI_Bcast(diagonal.data(), mpiCount(block_rows * block_rows, communicator), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                  diagonal_root, communicator);
+
+        // Install the factored diagonal block on its distributed rows.
+        for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
+            const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;
+            double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
+            const std::size_t diagonal_row = row - block_start;
+            for (std::size_t column = 0; column <= diagonal_row; ++column) {
+                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
+                    diagonal[diagonal_row * block_rows + column];
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Solve L(i, block) * L(block, block)^T = A(i, block) for rows below
+        // the diagonal block.  This is independent for every local row.
+        for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
+            const std::size_t row = row_start + local_row;
+            if (row < block_end) {
+                continue;
+            }
+
+            double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
+            for (std::size_t column = 0; column < block_rows; ++column) {
+                double value = matrix_row[block_start + column];
+                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < column; ++k) {
+                    value -= matrix_row[block_start + k] * diagonal[column * block_rows + k];
+                }
+                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
+                    value / diagonal[column * block_rows + column];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    return true;
+}

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        int rank = 0;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI message is too large for MPI_Gatherv/Allgatherv\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(communicator, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }

+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    ends.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < process_count; ++rank) {
+        starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank + 1) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+    }
+}

+int ownerOfRow(const std::vector<std::size_t>& ends, const std::size_t row) {
+    // Empty row blocks are possible when there are more ranks than rows.
+    // upper_bound therefore selects the first non-empty block containing row.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(ends.begin(), ends.end(), row) - ends.begin());

+                        off_diagonal -= diagonal[below * block_rows + k] *

+                    }
+                    diagonal[below * block_rows + row] =
+                        off_diagonal / diagonal[row * block_rows + row];
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Bcast(&factorization_ok, 1, MPI_INT, diagonal_root, communicator);
+        if (!factorization_ok) {
+            return false;
+        }
+        MPI_Bcast(diagonal.data(), mpiCount(block_rows * block_rows, communicator), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                  diagonal_root, communicator);
+
+        // Install the factored diagonal block on its distributed rows.
+        for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
+            const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;
+            double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
+            const std::size_t diagonal_row = row - block_start;
+            for (std::size_t column = 0; column <= diagonal_row; ++column) {
+                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
+                    diagonal[diagonal_row * block_rows + column];
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Solve L(i, block) * L(block, block)^T = A(i, block) for rows below
+        // the diagonal block.  This is independent for every local row.
+        for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
+            const std::size_t row = row_start + local_row;
+            if (row < block_end) {
+                continue;
+            }
+
+            double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
+            for (std::size_t column = 0; column < block_rows; ++column) {
+                double value = matrix_row[block_start + column];
+                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < column; ++k) {
+                    value -= matrix_row[block_start + k] * diagonal[column * block_rows + k];
+                }
+                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
+                    value / diagonal[column * block_rows + column];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    return true;
+}

Multi-rank execution is working with the available Intel MPI launcher: 2, 3, and 4 ranks all pass validation, including uneven ownership and more ranks than rows. The serialized result statistics are stable across ranks, and the factorization remains root-output-only. #include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>

#include <mpi.h>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

// The matrix is distributed by contiguous row blocks.  A rank owns all
// columns of its rows, but only the lower triangle is modified after the
// factorization starts.  This keeps the local access pattern contiguous and
// avoids the replicated n-by-n allocation in the original benchmark.

namespace {

int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
        int rank = 0;
        MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
        if (rank == 0) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI message is too large for MPI_Gatherv/Allgatherv\n");
        }
        MPI_Abort(communicator, EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    return static_cast<int>(count);
}

void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
    ends.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));

    for (int rank = 0; rank < process_count; ++rank) {
        starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank + 1) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
    }
}

int ownerOfRow(const std::vector<std::size_t>& ends, const std::size_t row) {
    // Empty row blocks are possible when there are more ranks than rows.
    // upper_bound therefore selects the first non-empty block containing row.
    return static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(ends.begin(), ends.end(), row) - ends.begin());
}

// Generate A = B * B^T + nI without constructing B or A on every rank.
// Ranks generate contiguous pieces of the original rand_r stream, then a
// ring exchanges B's row blocks so each rank can form its own rows of A.
void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& local_a, const std::size_t n,
                                    const std::size_t row_start,
                                    const std::size_t local_rows,
                                    const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_starts,
                                    const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_ends,
                                    const MPI_Comm communicator) {
    int rank = 0;
    int process_count = 1;
    MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
    MPI_Comm_size(communicator, &process_count);

    std::vector<double> local_b(local_rows * n);

    // Passing the rand_r state along the row partition preserves the input
    // matrix generated by the sequential benchmark exactly, without making
    // random-number generation a replicated-memory operation.
    unsigned int seed = 42;
    if (rank != 0) {
        MPI_Recv(&seed, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED, rank - 1, 4100, communicator, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);
    }
    for (double& value : local_b) {
        value = (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 0.5;
    }
    if (rank + 1 < process_count) {
        MPI_Send(&seed, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED, rank + 1, 4100, communicator);
    }

    local_a.assign(local_rows * n, 0.0);

    std::size_t maximum_rows = 0;
    for (int process = 0; process < process_count; ++process) {
        maximum_rows = std::max(maximum_rows,
                                row_ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] -
                                    row_starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)]);
    }

    std::vector<double> current_b(maximum_rows * n);
    std::vector<double> received_b(maximum_rows * n);
    std::copy(local_b.begin(), local_b.end(), current_b.begin());

    int current_owner = rank;
    std::size_t current_rows = local_rows;
    const int next = (rank + 1) % process_count;
    const int previous = (rank + process_count - 1) % process_count;

    for (int step = 0; step < process_count; ++step) {
        const std::size_t current_row_start = row_starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(current_owner)];

        for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
            const double* const left = local_b.data() + local_row * n;
            double* const output = local_a.data() + local_row * n;

            for (std::size_t received_row = 0; received_row < current_rows; ++received_row) {
                const double* const right = current_b.data() + received_row * n;
                double sum = 0.0;
                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                    sum += left[k] * right[k];
                }
                output[current_row_start + received_row] = sum;
            }
        }

        if (step + 1 < process_count) {
            const int received_owner = (current_owner + process_count - 1) % process_count;
            const std::size_t received_rows =
                row_ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(received_owner)] -
                row_starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(received_owner)];

            MPI_Sendrecv(current_b.data(), mpiCount(current_rows * n, communicator), MPI_DOUBLE,
                         next, 4101, received_b.data(),
                         mpiCount(received_rows * n, communicator), MPI_DOUBLE, previous, 4101,
                         communicator, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);

            current_b.swap(received_b);
            current_owner = received_owner;
            current_rows = received_rows;
        }
    }

    for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
        local_a[local_row * n + row_start + local_row] += static_cast<double>(n);
    }
}

// Blocked left-looking Cholesky.  At the start of a block, the rows of the
// already factored panel needed by that block are all-gathered once.  Each
// rank then updates its rows and solves the block below the diagonal locally.
// Only the small diagonal block is gathered to one rank for POTRF and then
// broadcast, so the full matrix is never replicated during the factorization.
bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local_a, const std::size_t n,
                           const std::size_t row_start, const std::size_t local_rows,
                           const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_starts,
                           const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_ends,
                           const MPI_Comm communicator, const std::size_t requested_block_size) {
    int rank = 0;
    int process_count = 1;
    MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
    MPI_Comm_size(communicator, &process_count);

    if (n == 0) {
        return true;
    }

    const std::size_t block_size = std::max<std::size_t>(1, std::min(requested_block_size, n));
    std::vector<int> panel_counts(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
    std::vector<int> panel_displacements(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
    std::vector<int> diagonal_counts(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
    std::vector<int> diagonal_displacements(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));

    for (std::size_t block_start = 0; block_start < n; block_start += block_size) {
        const std::size_t block_rows = std::min(block_size, n - block_start);
        const std::size_t block_end = block_start + block_rows;

        const std::size_t local_block_start = std::max(row_start, block_start);
        const std::size_t local_block_end = std::min(row_start + local_rows, block_end);
        const std::size_t local_block_row_count =
            local_block_end > local_block_start ? local_block_end - local_block_start : 0;

        std::vector<double> previous_panel;
        if (block_start != 0) {
            previous_panel.assign(block_rows * block_start, 0.0);
            std::vector<double> panel_to_share(local_block_row_count * block_start);

            for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
                const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;
                std::copy_n(local_a.data() + local_row * n, block_start,
                            panel_to_share.data() + (row - local_block_start) * block_start);
            }

            for (int process = 0; process < process_count; ++process) {
                const std::size_t process_first =
                    std::max(row_starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_start);
                const std::size_t process_last =
                    std::min(row_ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_end);
                const std::size_t process_rows =
                    process_last > process_first ? process_last - process_first : 0;
                panel_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
                    mpiCount(process_rows * block_start, communicator);
                panel_displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
                    mpiCount((process_rows == 0 ? 0 : process_first - block_start) * block_start,
                             communicator);
            }

            MPI_Allgatherv(panel_to_share.data(),
                           panel_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)], MPI_DOUBLE,
                           previous_panel.data(), panel_counts.data(), panel_displacements.data(),
                           MPI_DOUBLE, communicator);

            // Update the current panel with the contribution from all earlier
            // columns.  The inner product order is kept increasing in k, as
            // in the original unblocked implementation.
            for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
                const std::size_t row = row_start + local_row;
                if (row < block_start) {
                    continue;
                }

                double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
                const std::size_t row_end = std::min(row + 1, block_end);
                for (std::size_t column = block_start; column < row_end; ++column) {
                    double value = matrix_row[column];
                    const double* const panel_row =
                        previous_panel.data() + (column - block_start) * block_start;
                    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < block_start; ++k) {
                        value -= matrix_row[k] * panel_row[k];
                    }
                    matrix_row[column] = value;
                }
            }
        }

        std::vector<double> diagonal_to_gather(local_block_row_count * block_rows);
        for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
            const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;
            std::copy_n(local_a.data() + local_row * n + block_start, block_rows,
                        diagonal_to_gather.data() + (row - local_block_start) * block_rows);
                        diagonal_to_gather.data() + (row - local_block_start) * block_rows);
        }

        for (int process = 0; process < process_count; ++process) {
            const std::size_t process_first =
                std::max(row_starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_start);
            const std::size_t process_last =
                std::min(row_ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_end);
            const std::size_t process_rows =
                process_last > process_first ? process_last - process_first : 0;
            diagonal_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
                mpiCount(process_rows * block_rows, communicator);
            diagonal_displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
                mpiCount((process_rows == 0 ? 0 : process_first - block_start) * block_rows,
                         communicator);
        }

        const int diagonal_root = ownerOfRow(row_ends, block_start);
        std::vector<double> diagonal(block_rows * block_rows, 0.0);
        MPI_Gatherv(diagonal_to_gather.data(), diagonal_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)],
                    MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal.data(), diagonal_counts.data(),
                    diagonal_displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal_root, communicator);

        int factorization_ok = 1;
        if (rank == diagonal_root) {
            for (std::size_t row = 0; row < block_rows; ++row) {
                double sum = 0.0;
                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < row; ++k) {
                    const double value = diagonal[row * block_rows + k];
                    sum += value * value;
                }

                const double value = diagonal[row * block_rows + row] - sum;
                if (value <= 0.0) {
                    std::printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\n",
                                block_start + row);
                    factorization_ok = 0;
                    break;
                }
                diagonal[row * block_rows + row] = std::sqrt(value);

                for (std::size_t below = row + 1; below < block_rows; ++below) {
                    double off_diagonal = diagonal[below * block_rows + row];
                    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < row; ++k) {
                        off_diagonal -= diagonal[below * block_rows + k] *
                                        diagonal[row * block_rows + k];
                    }
                    diagonal[below * block_rows + row] =
                        off_diagonal / diagonal[row * block_rows + row];
                }
            }
        }

        MPI_Bcast(&factorization_ok, 1, MPI_INT, diagonal_root, communicator);
        if (!factorization_ok) {
            return false;
        }
        MPI_Bcast(diagonal.data(), mpiCount(block_rows * block_rows, communicator), MPI_DOUBLE,
                  diagonal_root, communicator);

        // Install the factored diagonal block on its distributed rows.
        for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
            const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;
            double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
            const std::size_t diagonal_row = row - block_start;
            for (std::size_t column = 0; column <= diagonal_row; ++column) {
                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
                    diagonal[diagonal_row * block_rows + column];
            }
        }

        // Solve L(i, block) * L(block, block)^T = A(i, block) for rows below
        // the diagonal block.  This is independent for every local row.
        for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
            const std::size_t row = row_start + local_row;
            if (row < block_end) {
                continue;
            }

            double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
            for (std::size_t column = 0; column < block_rows; ++column) {
                double value = matrix_row[block_start + column];
                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < column; ++k) {
                    value -= matrix_row[block_start + k] * diagonal[column * block_rows + k];
                }
                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
                    value / diagonal[column * block_rows + column];
            }
        }
    }

    return true;
}

void gatherRows(const std::vector<double>& local_a, std::vector<double>& global_a,
                const std::size_t n, const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_starts,
                const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_ends, const MPI_Comm communicator,
                const int root) {
    int rank = 0;
    int process_count = 1;
    MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
    MPI_Comm_size(communicator, &process_count);

    std::vector<int> counts(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
    std::vector<int> displacements(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
    for (int process = 0; process < process_count; ++process) {
        const std::size_t process_index = static_cast<std::size_t>(process);
        counts[process_index] = mpiCount((row_ends[process_index] - row_starts[process_index]) * n,
                                         communicator);
        displacements[process_index] = mpiCount(row_starts[process_index] * n, communicator);
    }

    if (rank == root) {
        global_a.resize(n * n);
    }

    MPI_Gatherv(local_a.data(), counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)], MPI_DOUBLE,
                rank == root ? global_a.data() : nullptr, counts.data(), displacements.data(),
                MPI_DOUBLE, root, communicator);
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    std::printf("Options:\n");
    std::printf("  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\n");
    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

} // namespace

// Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with the original matrix.
bool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,
                      const std::size_t n) {
    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (std::size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (std::size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];
            }
            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;
        }
    }

    double maxError = 0.0;
    double relError = 0.0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {
        const double error = std::fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);
        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);

        const double relative = error / (std::fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);
        relError = std::max(relError, relative);
    }

    std::printf("Max absolute error: %.10e\n", maxError);
    std::printf("Max relative error: %.10e\n", relError);

    if (relError > 1e-6) {
        std::printf("Validation failed: relative error too large\n");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);

    int rank = 0;
    int process_count = 1;
    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &process_count);

    std::size_t n = 512;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    bool parse_ok = true;

    for (int argument = 1; argument < argc; ++argument) {
        if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-n") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
            char* end = nullptr;
            const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(argv[++argument], &end, 10);
            if (end == argv[argument] || *end != '\0') {
                parse_ok = false;
            } else {
                n = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
            }
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-h") == 0) {
            if (rank == 0) {
                printUsage(argv[0]);
            }
            MPI_Finalize();
            return 0;
        } else {
            parse_ok = false;
        }
    }

    if (!parse_ok) {
        if (rank == 0) {
            std::printf("Invalid command line arguments\n");
            printUsage(argv[0]);
        }
        MPI_Finalize();
        return 1;
    }

    std::vector<std::size_t> row_starts;
    std::vector<std::size_t> row_ends;
    makeRowPartition(n, process_count, row_starts, row_ends);
    const std::size_t row_start = row_starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)];
    const std::size_t local_rows =
        row_ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] - row_start;

    if (rank == 0) {
        std::printf("Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\n");
        std::printf("Matrix size: %zu x %zu\n", n, n);
        std::printf("MPI processes: %d\n", process_count);
        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
        std::printf("Generating positive definite matrix...\n");
    }

    std::vector<double> local_a;
    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(local_a, n, row_start, local_rows, row_starts, row_ends,
                                   MPI_COMM_WORLD);

    std::vector<double> local_original;
    if (validate) {
        local_original = local_a;
    }

    if (rank == 0) {
        std::printf("Computing Cholesky decomposition...\n");
    }
    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
    const double start = MPI_Wtime();

    // A tile of 128 doubles gives the panel collectives enough payload to
    // amortize latency while keeping diagonal work cache resident.
    const bool success = choleskyDecomposition(local_a, n, row_start, local_rows, row_starts,
                                               row_ends, MPI_COMM_WORLD, 128);

    const double local_duration = MPI_Wtime() - start;
    double duration = 0.0;
    MPI_Reduce(&local_duration, &duration, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);

    if (!success) {
        if (rank == 0) {
            std::printf("Cholesky decomposition failed\n");
        }
        MPI_Finalize();
        return 1;
    }

    if (rank == 0) {
        const long duration_ms = static_cast<long>(duration * 1000.0);
        std::printf("Computation time: %ld ms\n", duration_ms);

        const double operations = static_cast<double>(n) * static_cast<double>(n) *
                                  static_cast<double>(n) / 3.0;
        const double gflops = duration > 0.0 ? operations / duration / 1e9 : 0.0;
        std::printf("Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\n", gflops);
    }

    std::vector<double> global_a;
    std::vector<double> global_original;
    if (validate || printResults) {
        // Match the original result semantics: upper-triangular output is
        // explicitly zeroed before optional printing or validation.
        for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
            const std::size_t row = row_start + local_row;
            for (std::size_t column = row + 1; column < n; ++column) {
                local_a[local_row * n + column] = 0.0;
            }
        }

        gatherRows(local_a, global_a, n, row_starts, row_ends, MPI_COMM_WORLD, 0);
        if (validate) {
            gatherRows(local_original, global_original, n, row_starts, row_ends,
                       MPI_COMM_WORLD, 0);
        }
    }

    int validation_ok = 1;
    if (rank == 0 && printResults) {
        print_results(global_a, "CholeskyL");
    }

    if (validate) {
        if (rank == 0) {
            std::printf("Validating result...\n");
            validation_ok = validateCholesky(global_a, global_original, n) ? 1 : 0;
            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validation_ok ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
        }
        MPI_Bcast(&validation_ok, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
    }

    MPI_Finalize();
    return validation_ok == 1 ? 0 : 1;
}

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {

+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {

+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =

+                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
+                    diagonal[diagonal_row * block_rows + column];
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Solve L(i, block) * L(block, block)^T = A(i, block) for rows below
+        // the diagonal block.  This is independent for every local row.
+        for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
+            const std::size_t row = row_start + local_row;
+            if (row < block_end) {
+                continue;
+            }
+
+            double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
+            for (std::size_t column = 0; column < block_rows; ++column) {
+                double value = matrix_row[block_start + column];
+                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < column; ++k) {
+                    value -= matrix_row[block_start + k] * diagonal[column * block_rows + k];
+                }
+                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
+                    value / diagonal[column * block_rows + column];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    return true;
+}

+int mpiCount(const std::size_t count, const MPI_Comm communicator) {
+    if (count > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        int rank = 0;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI message is too large for MPI_Gatherv/Allgatherv\n");
+        }
+        MPI_Abort(communicator, EXIT_FAILURE);

+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));

+
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < process_count; ++rank) {

+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+            n * static_cast<std::size_t>(rank + 1) / static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count);
+    }

+// rank then updates its rows and solves the block below the diagonal locally.
+// Only the small diagonal block is gathered to one rank for POTRF and then
+// broadcast, so the full matrix is never replicated during the factorization.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& local_a, const std::size_t n,
+                           const std::size_t row_start, const std::size_t local_rows,
+                           const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_starts,
+                           const std::vector<std::size_t>& row_ends,
+                           const MPI_Comm communicator, const std::size_t requested_block_size) {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int process_count = 1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+    MPI_Comm_size(communicator, &process_count);
+
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
     }
-    
-    // Compute A = B * B^T
-    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
-        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
-            double sum = 0.0;
-            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
-                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];
+
+    const std::size_t block_size = std::max<std::size_t>(1, std::min(requested_block_size, n));
+    std::vector<int> panel_counts(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    std::vector<int> panel_displacements(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    std::vector<int> diagonal_counts(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+    std::vector<int> diagonal_displacements(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));
+
+    for (std::size_t block_start = 0; block_start < n; block_start += block_size) {
+        const std::size_t block_rows = std::min(block_size, n - block_start);
+        const std::size_t block_end = block_start + block_rows;
+
+        const std::size_t local_block_start = std::max(row_start, block_start);
+        const std::size_t local_block_end = std::min(row_start + local_rows, block_end);
+        const std::size_t local_block_row_count =
+            local_block_end > local_block_start ? local_block_end - local_block_start : 0;
+
+        std::vector<double> previous_panel;
+        if (block_start != 0) {
+            previous_panel.assign(block_rows * block_start, 0.0);
+            std::vector<double> panel_to_share(local_block_row_count * block_start);
+
+            for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
+                const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;
+                std::copy_n(local_a.data() + local_row * n, block_start,
+                            panel_to_share.data() + (row - local_block_start) * block_start);
+            }
+
+            for (int process = 0; process < process_count; ++process) {
+                const std::size_t process_first =
+                    std::max(row_starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_start);
+                const std::size_t process_last =
+                    std::min(row_ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_end);
+                const std::size_t process_rows =
+                    process_last > process_first ? process_last - process_first : 0;
+                panel_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
+                    mpiCount(process_rows * block_start, communicator);
+                panel_displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
+                    mpiCount((process_rows == 0 ? 0 : process_first - block_start) * block_start,
+                             communicator);
+            }
+
+            MPI_Allgatherv(panel_to_share.data(),
+                           panel_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)], MPI_DOUBLE,
+                           previous_panel.data(), panel_counts.data(), panel_displacements.data(),
+                           MPI_DOUBLE, communicator);
+
+            // Update the current panel with the contribution from all earlier
+            // columns.  The inner product order is kept increasing in k, as
+            // in the original unblocked implementation.
+            for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
+                const std::size_t row = row_start + local_row;
+                if (row < block_start) {
+                    continue;
+                }
+
+                double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
+                const std::size_t row_end = std::min(row + 1, block_end);
+                for (std::size_t column = block_start; column < row_end; ++column) {
+                    double value = matrix_row[column];
+                    const double* const panel_row =
+                        previous_panel.data() + (column - block_start) * block_start;
+                    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < block_start; ++k) {
+                        value -= matrix_row[k] * panel_row[k];
+                    }
+                    matrix_row[column] = value;
+                }
             }

+        std::vector<double> diagonal_to_gather(local_block_row_count * block_rows);
+        for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
+            const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;
+            std::copy_n(local_a.data() + local_row * n + block_start, block_rows,
+                        diagonal_to_gather.data() + (row - local_block_start) * block_rows);
+        }
+
+        for (int process = 0; process < process_count; ++process) {
+            const std::size_t process_first =
+                std::max(row_starts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_start);
+            const std::size_t process_last =
+                std::min(row_ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)], block_end);
+            const std::size_t process_rows =
+                process_last > process_first ? process_last - process_first : 0;
+            diagonal_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
+                mpiCount(process_rows * block_rows, communicator);
+            diagonal_displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(process)] =
+                mpiCount((process_rows == 0 ? 0 : process_first - block_start) * block_rows,
+                         communicator);
+        }
+
+        const int diagonal_root = ownerOfRow(row_ends, block_start);
+        std::vector<double> diagonal(block_rows * block_rows, 0.0);
+        MPI_Gatherv(diagonal_to_gather.data(), diagonal_counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)],
+                    MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal.data(), diagonal_counts.data(),
+                    diagonal_displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal_root, communicator);
+
+        int factorization_ok = 1;
+        if (rank == diagonal_root) {
+            for (std::size_t row = 0; row < block_rows; ++row) {
+                double sum = 0.0;
+                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < row; ++k) {
+                    const double value = diagonal[row * block_rows + k];
+                    sum += value * value;
+                }
+
+                const double value = diagonal[row * block_rows + row] - sum;
+                if (value <= 0.0) {
+                    std::printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\n",
+                                block_start + row);
+                    factorization_ok = 0;
+                    break;
+                }
+                diagonal[row * block_rows + row] = std::sqrt(value);
+
+                for (std::size_t below = row + 1; below < block_rows; ++below) {
+                    double off_diagonal = diagonal[below * block_rows + row];
+                    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < row; ++k) {
+                        off_diagonal -= diagonal[below * block_rows + k] *
+                                        diagonal[row * block_rows + k];
+                    }
+                    diagonal[below * block_rows + row] =
+                        off_diagonal / diagonal[row * block_rows + row];
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Bcast(&factorization_ok, 1, MPI_INT, diagonal_root, communicator);
+        if (!factorization_ok) {
+            return false;
+        }
+        MPI_Bcast(diagonal.data(), mpiCount(block_rows * block_rows, communicator), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                  diagonal_root, communicator);
+
+        // Install the factored diagonal block on its distributed rows.
+        for (std::size_t row = local_block_start; row < local_block_end; ++row) {
+            const std::size_t local_row = row - row_start;
+            double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
+            const std::size_t diagonal_row = row - block_start;
+            for (std::size_t column = 0; column <= diagonal_row; ++column) {
+                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
+                    diagonal[diagonal_row * block_rows + column];
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Solve L(i, block) * L(block, block)^T = A(i, block) for rows below
+        // the diagonal block.  This is independent for every local row.
+        for (std::size_t local_row = 0; local_row < local_rows; ++local_row) {
+            const std::size_t row = row_start + local_row;
+            if (row < block_end) {
+                continue;
+            }
+
+            double* const matrix_row = local_a.data() + local_row * n;
+            for (std::size_t column = 0; column < block_rows; ++column) {
+                double value = matrix_row[block_start + column];
+                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < column; ++k) {
+                    value -= matrix_row[block_start + k] * diagonal[column * block_rows + k];
+                }
+                matrix_row[block_start + column] =
+                    value / diagonal[column * block_rows + column];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    return true;

+void makeRowPartition(const std::size_t n, const int process_count,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& starts,
+                      std::vector<std::size_t>& ends) {
+    starts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(process_count));

+        ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
